annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds persons operating Unmanned Systems (drone owners and operators/remote pilots), persons or entities importing, manufacturing, assembling, selling, distributing or leasing drones (who must be accredited), and government agencies tasked with implementation and enforcement.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Any person or entity engaged in the importation, manufacture, assembly, sale, distribution, or lease of drones in the Philippines shall secure the appropriate accreditation from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI)
annotation.dates_quote: This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This Act shall be known as the "Unmanned Systems Regulation and Safety Act of 2026".
